programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Discover how dogs have evolved from wild predators to friendly pets. Plus, a look at parts of the world where dogs are spoiled as much as children.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: Designer Antonio Ballatore and his team build a cats-only treehouse. Linked to the family room, Taffy and her ten-year-old owner can now play in style.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Boone receives an anonymous tip about a hunter who illegally shot a deer. Plus, McGee questions a man for being in possession of venomous copperhead snakes.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: As the first snow falls, the Browns make a risky attempt to move their shelters closer to the barn. Noah prepares his pregnant wife Rhain for her first bush winter.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: The Wolfpack kids have divided their land between themselves. They're keen to finish building their houses in time as Noah prepares for the baby's arrival.

programme.title: Dodo Heroes
programme.desc: Donna Stepan runs Sleepy Burrow Wombat Sanctuary. When she takes in a new orphaned baby in critical condition, the next 24 hours become a fight for its life.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino for a life-saving vaccine. Meanwhile, Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in bad shape.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: The keepers wave goodbye to two elephant brothers as they start their new adventure at a zoo in Texas. Plus, two African penguin chicks join the colony.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: The Raneys help a family struggling to survive in their home made of 30,000 tire bales. They are battling intruding pests, flooding, and unstable walls.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff visits a free clinic and returns with a dog who was hit by a car. Plus, he helps a dog with a mysterious lump and Dr. Baier wants to keep a rescue puppy.

programme.title: Tanked

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: The Game Wardens educate a dog owner about leaving pets in the sun. An underage drinker tells too many lies. And, Wardens inspect novice jet skiers on a busy lake.

programme.title: Project Grizzly
programme.desc: Renowned bear handler Jeff Watson sets out on an adventure to teach his two 700lb grizzly bears, Bob and Screech, how to survive on their own in the wild.

programme.title: Pit Bulls And Parolees

programme.title: My Cat From Hell
programme.desc: A vicious cat is preventing Rob and Stephanie from having a baby while Jessica's cat chases her around her house, scratching everything. Can Jackson Galaxy help?

programme.title: Tanked

programme.title: Animal Cops Philadelphia

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: Gumball is traumatized when accidentally kissed on the mouth by his Grandma JoJo.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin are invited to a high school party, and have to bring a date!

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin unsuccessfully attempt to get a refund for their computer game.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 1
programme.desc: Gumball discovers that Bobert is planning to steal his identity and replace him.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Clayton shapeshifts into people to take their detentions for money. He starts framing people for misdemeanors so GB and DW must track him down to stop him.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: When people that barely know each other start falling in love Gumball thinks he knows who's behind it. He rushes to Sarah's house and finds her writing in a magic notebook that turns everything in it into reality. When everything in Elmore gets crazier and crazier there's only one thing for it: they have to write their way out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Anais has been facepalming every time her family does something stupid which has led to a serious medical condition. In fact if she facepalms just one more time she could do her brain irreparable damage so the Wattersons have to get through the week without doing anything idiotic.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball is late to meet Penny at the mall.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball tries to convince Leslie he's an expert on all things plant-related. However when Leslie realizes Gumball hasn't got a clue what he's talking about he decides to call his bluff. An escalation of dangerous dares and stunts ensue as they try to out-plant each other.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: After accidentally bumping into each other in the grocery aisle Nicole and her parents have it out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: When Nicole decides to pay the cable bill in person at Chanax she leaves specific instructions for Richard to stay in the car. However he's far too tempted by the vending machine in the foyer to follow her advice. Chanax believes Richard is their mysterious founder and follow his every whim leading to their inevitable demise.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin are at the convenience store considering playing truant. Larry warns them that if they don't take their education seriously they'll end up like him. To prove his point Larry lets Gumball and Darwin work some of his many roles to make them appreciate the value of a good education.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin argue with the Internet.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin learn that Hector is not so happy being giant-sized. So they decide to help him by creating a potion that will shrink him down to the size of an average person. However creating a magic potion is not as easy as it sounds and the results can go spectacularly wrong...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Darwin asks Gumball to teach him how to skate.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin follow Nicole to the Rainbow Factory for Bring your Kids to Work Day. They are expecting a magical place full of dreams and wonder but it turns out to be a little less magical than they'd hoped. Despite the fact nobody wants them there they end up saving the factory from being closed down.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Darwin tries to highlight the plight of all the household objects he feels are being oppressed and maltreated by the uncaring residents of Elmore. He then decides to lead those objects in a revolt against the townspeople.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: The boys manage to lose Polly in the blink of an eye.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Nicole has decided it's time to throw out the family's refrigerator. This doesn't go down too well with Richard as it's his favorite possession. When it turns out the refrigerator is also a magical storage facility for childhood emotions and memories it makes sense that Richard is having a hard time letting go.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: When Mr Robinson accidentally lets slip how little he cares for Gumball and Darwin, they react by giving him the cold shoulder. Surprisingly Mr Robinson misses them and tries to win back their friendship. After a few failed attempts, Gumball and Darwin realise that Mr Robinson's heart is protecting him, so they give it an intense affection overload.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball's old BFF, Fuzzy, turns up on his doorstep. Darwin struggles to accept that there was someone before him and fails to contain his jealousy. But is Darwin right to mistrust Fuzzy? Does Fuzzy actually have sinister motives for reconnecting with his old BFF?

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin's clothes go missing after a swimming lesson, and Gumball is forced to wear a tuxedo from the lost and found office. He believes it makes him look like a certain dapper British secret agent and, together with Darwin and Bobert (and far too many wisecracks) Gumball tracks down the villain responsible for stealing his clothes.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: When everything goes wrong in Darwin's life he begins to suspect that Gumball's bad influence might be to blame. Darwin decides to go elsewhere for guidance and finds a new mentor in Alan. But maybe it's time Darwin started making his own decisions.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin realize that the adult residents of Elmore are dangerously naive when it comes to being safe online. In fact they are in serious need of the boys help with even the simplest of tasks. And none more so than their mom, Nicole.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: The students of Elmore Junior High find their world turned upside down when the mysterious school superintendent comes to stamp out their cartoonish ways. But who wants to be normal? Certainly not Gumball and Darwin...

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: When Lamput masquerades as a swimming trophy at the local pool, Skinny finds himself in his red trunks, warming up for the big race. You’d be surprised at how fast a Doc can swim when there’s a Lamput up for grabs. Skinny discovers skills not even he was aware of. Shame the trophies keep switching places. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a giant jelly cake. Their chase leads them to the castle library, where the Lemmings accidentally activate the opening of a secret passage.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a card that enables them to teleport a magic closet.

Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry puts Tuffy to sleep but Tuffy sneaks out to play in his dollhouse. Tom sees Tuffy and tries to catch him. Tuffy and Jerry dress up in costumes to try and escape Tom. Tom chases them into the dollhouse but he is too big and ends up wearing the house instead.

programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing. Enough to infallibly track down the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings clumsily destroy the TV remote control while fighting over who gets to watch their favorite program. While looking for a backup zapper, they happen onto a top secret Canadian Army prototype that enables you to apply the usual controls: play, pause and fast forward to living beings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that by changing the speed limit sign on the side of the road, they can accelerate truck traffic and create a huge draft that is just perfect for their extreme kiting game. programme.title: Lamput - Season 3

Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.desc: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has just delivered his beloved. But first, he'll have to stop the Lemmings' fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves, following a complicated recipe. If they can make it, then why can’t he?

programme.desc: Three New Kazoom Kids—friends of Finn, Kai, and Mia—appear unexpectedly in Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels soar through space in their Bat-Rocket and have to navigate all sorts of orbiting obstacles to reach Badcomputer’s satellite.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Sunny Seagull hires The Looney Builders to build a carnival on Looneyburg’s pier. The crew gets so caught up trying to win the games that they lose sight of what matters.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Lola leads the crew in washing their vehicles only to discover she mixed up the job assignments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is obsessed by his favourite TV hero ‘Super Spy’ and is excited when his very own Super-Spy spy kit arrives in the post. While Mr Bean is pretending to be his favourite character and delighting in all his gadgets he spots some unusual goings on in the Bruisers’ house next door. Naturally Mr Bean assumes the worst and sets out to rectify the situation.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly! It doesn't take Grizzy long to figure this out and the bear rapidly imagines himself as Peter Pan sipping on his easily-harvested coconut milk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with laser party favors and are propelled onto an unknown planet: a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge. Grizzy and the Lemmings will do everything to break up this budding romance and recover the cold sources that are rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears. Grizzy is now obliged to treat them like brothers as well.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput shows kindness to a nearby spider - and in the process makes a valuable ally. Good thing, too, because the mozzies around here are diabolical.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Gardener finally gets his hands on Manny, Moley and Dotty are on his trail, so he dresses up as the world’s greatest Mole detective and lead them away from the clues.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mishmosh’s new de-aging device causes trouble when it accidentally zaps Miss Petunia and Old Coot into their younger selves. But Moley soon discovers that the de-aging doesn’t stop and he and his friends must rescue them before it’s too late.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty go on a wild adventure after getting transformed into worms, only to discover that Squirm comes from a whole new alien world that has been under MoleTown the entire time!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mishmosh falls ill and is unable to compete in MoleTown’s greatest inventor competition, Moley and Dotty must dress up and compete in his place against other great Mole inventors!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the anniversary of Moley becoming the keeper of Manny, and Dotty, with a little help from her Uncle Mishmosh, goes back in time to see what she had missed before she came to MoleTown.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep wants to be brave enough to join in the daring games that Mush-Mush and Lilit like to play. So he gets some protective moss pants that make him not only indestructible but also fashionable… and a bit cocky. Woo, it’s the new Chep!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Mush-Mush really wants to get over his fear of snakes. Truff really wants to get over his fear of ants. So they team up to help each other overcome their fears… maybe.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Mushpot offers to look after the Mushies so Mushpie can get a well-earned rest. He thinks it will be easy. It is not easy! The Mushies end up pushing both Mushpot and Starmush to their limit.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Sushi-Mushi’s excitement and pride over Chanterelle doing a portrait of him to hang in his restaurant turns to worry. What if his friends don’t like it? But, of course, Chanterelle would never let that happen.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Wanting to show the Mushies that they should fly high and follow their dreams, Mushpie starts leaf-gliding for the first time. But soon she is flying way too high!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom, Multy, and Kid Fury team up one last time to divert the Titan Fury. Kaboom City is saved and it's time to go home.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: As Rick and Ginger prepare for a costume party, Tom tries to score some snacks. Jerry and Tuffy are out to do the same. Spike and Tom are initially confused by the guests' costumes. Determined to get their paws on as much party food as they can, however, they contrive their own costumes to crash the party. Will they get away with it?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Catsylvania, zombie cats pop up out of the ground as Tom passes a cemetery, so Tom runs to Jerry Van Mouseling for help. At first, the mouse thinks Tom is a zombie cat or Frankenstein-cat and tries repelling him. However, once Jerry understands the problem, he and his band of angry peasant mice help fight the zombie cats.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Rick and Ginger wake up late and, in their hurry, they accidentally put dog food in Tom's bowl and cat food in Spike's. This causes Spike to behave like a cat and Tom to act like a dog. Although they're confused at first, they soon eat other types of food and discover how it makes them act.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: While Rick and Ginger take a mountain hike, Tom and Jerry befriend three cute baby eaglets and help them learn to fly. However, soon Tom must face a bobcat.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Spike orders Tom and Jerry to watch Tyke while he's away, but instead Tom takes the opportunity to chase Jerry in the backyard. Suddenly, Tyke is nowhere to be seen and the front gate is wide open! Tom and Jerry must find the pup in time or face Spike's beating.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up. Freezing air sweeps into the cabin. Seeking a source of heat, Grizzy decides to move into the science station greenhouse where the temperature is controlled by a drone. But the bear is unaware of what he carries in his luggage: the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a new playmate: a walrus! The rodents ride the creature throughout the cabin, then make him slide down the roof before starting all over again. Grizzy steps in and propels the creature to the back of a mysterious ice cave. In the center is a dolmen with a bone sitting on it. Whoever touches the bone becomes docile and prehistoric in appearance. The Lemmings dream up a scheme where Grizzy would submit to their will.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind. And what do you get for the teddy that has everything? A morning in a toy shop, burgers for lunch and a slap up tea party, of course. (But only if you can afford it.)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn. Bean looks to get hammered if he does not rid the old lady of the cuddly little half-blind culprit. He fails dismally with his eccentric mole extermination methods and ends up simply taking the pesky rodent for a ride.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: As the storm rages, Baby Owl's tree is struck by lightning! She's left without a nest. The Baby Lemmings seek shelter from the wind, and find refuge in a crumbling cave. They decide to decorate it in a makeover style. Unintentionally, they take the items Baby Owl had prepared for her new nest. She comes to get them back, but the Baby Lemmings don't understand why.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum’s famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: How does one choose tasteful wallpaper these days? After watching a royal documentary on TV, Mr. Bean decides to decorate his room in the style of Buckingham Palace. If the Queen’s new wallpaper is good enough for Her Royal Highness, then it’s going to be good enough for him. Meanwhile, his landlady, Mrs. Wicket, suffers from illusions of grandeur and crowns herself Queen of the street.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun bouncing off the backs of green frogs while Grizzy chases some mosquitos buzzing around him. Displeased, the rodents replace Grizzy's green frogs with poisonous orange ones that paralyze anyone who touches them!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy comes home and discovers the Lemmings dancing madly and throws them into the jungle where they meet a parrot that can reproduce any sound. The bird becomes their ally to distract Grizzy and recover their musical equipment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize an obstacle course in their cabin. Grizzy ejects the Lemmings from the cabin and they crash onto an Incan temple where they discover a spheric object that can control the Earth's rotation.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings get hold of an old pinball machine and install it in the cabin. Their furious party interrupts Grizzy's nap and the bear threatens to break the contraption.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy, a big chocolate lover, is growing a young cacao tree under an ultraviolet lamp. During a trampoline session, the Lemmings accidentally break the lamp, provoking a supernatural reaction.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: During a fight, Grizzy and the Lemmings stumble upon a Mayan temple lost in the jungle. Once inside, they set off a magic reaction that creates doubles of themselves at different ages.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he’s tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: An errant piece of bubblegum stuck inside Bam threatens to blow up Batman's chance at stopping Joker on a fast-paced mission through the Gotham streets.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom. Grizzy is determined to make discipline reign but he has forgotten about the Lemming’s natural penchant for bedlam.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag. While Grizzy is tidying up the cabin after their fight, he is baffled to see the Lemmings come back him, quiet and calm. The rodents break out into Christmas carols and prepare a delicious snack for Grizzy before slipping out again. Suspicious, Grizzy follows them and discovers that the bag rewards persons whose wishes are equal to their goodwill.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While trying to stop the Lemmings from playing their extreme trampoline game, Grizzy slips on the canvas and unwittingly executes an amazing somersault in front of his beloved she-bear. Seeing that she wants more, Grizzy decides to become a champ in the sport. But for that to happen, the Lemmings will need to let him work out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have hitched up a racoon with a sweet tooth to their sled and get a ride by throwing cookies in front of the creature with a sling. To recover the supply of cookies, which were to be his afternoon snack, Grizzy has no qualms about making the Lemmings' sled skid out of control. When the sled hits a superhero's spacecraft, a mysterious costume falls out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a strange little gadget from amongst the Forest Ranger's belongings: a hand spinner. Grizzy thinks it's a silly game until he accidentally tries out the contraption for himself and becomes instantly addicted. What is the secret of this seemingly banal object that make the heads of its enthusiasts spin as well?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It might be Sunday, but Specs just won’t let up: his obsession with Lamput knows no weekends. Skinny, on the other hand, knows just how to spend his day off. Asleep, that’s how. Even if his workaholic buddy insists on dragging him through the usual pointless search. The call of a morning coffee wins the day, though; when Specs finally agrees to take a break, he discovers that even orange blobs like a sleep-in. And pancakes. Lots of pancakes.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During a great Parasaur family migration, the Ranchers spot trouble. The youngest, Sneezer, is under the weather with booming sneezes that startle even himself, causing him to bolt away in panic! Min manages to calm him down just in time! Confident, Min volunteers to nurse Sneezer back to health while also taking on Uncle Jack's HQ duties. But caring for dinos is no easy feat, especially alone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: First impressions can be tricky, especially when a protective mama sea turtle mistakes the Jungle Jetter for a predator! The frightened mother is injured in a chase, leaving the Dino Ranchers rushing to her rescue! Back at HQ, Min carefully treats the mama's wounds while the others watch over her tiny hatchlings, safely tucked inside a pen! But one mischievous baby, Shelly, has other plans!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill. As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover that bouncing on mushrooms makes a bass drum sound. The rhythmic sound makes Baby Lynx want to dance. Seeing her, the baby lemmings discover the joys of dancing and dance with her. But Baby Lynx wants to remain the center of attention and prevents the lemmings from dancing. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings discover a cave with a crystal on the ceiling that turns into a sort of disco ball, creating a real dance hall where they'd rather Baby Lynx didn't come.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that blowing into a leaf makes sounds that light up and even make fireflies dance! Meanwhile, the cowardly and tired Baby Moose is looking for a place to sleep. But as soon as the moon gets hidden, his fear of the dark makes him tremble and prevents him from getting any sleep. When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bigfoot mistakes Squeaks as Bugs' new cat and goes to every effort to return him to his rightful place.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Yosemite Sam attend a rodeo only to have their sideline shenanigans force them into the ring.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Slugsworthy builds a new mega-mansion right over Bugs' home so Bugs battles back for the right to his turf.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Wile has invented a machine that runs purely on walnut oil - Squeaks' main food source!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve and Fred is ready to solve a Christmas mystery! Unfortunately, the gang has arrived in a town that's being attacked by a Pterodactyl and it doesn't seem to have anything to do with Christmas!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to Ireland to visit an ancient Blake family castle. As the gang becomes enchanted by the magical Emerald Isle, an angry, rampaging Giant makes them reconsider just how wonderful all the old myths and legends really are.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem – but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger places her granny's old cuckoo clock in the hall, and it still works! However, the newly arrived clock causes issues when Tom wants to catch the tiny wooden bird inside and Tuffy wants to befriend it.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: At midnight, a gothic lady cat appears with her favorite sinister plant creatures including her personal favorite: Fang, a big man-eating plant. As long as it's sealed in the hothouse, nothing can go wrong. But Tom, Jerry and Tuffy soon have their hands full with the escaped plant.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Cates appears and assigns Tom the job of sweeping the estate's chimneys, warning him not to upset the Duchess's new exotic pet bird. Unfortunately, both the pet bird and a stork at the top of the chimney think Jerry is a worm. Soon chaos breaks out, hurting Tom's cleaning efforts.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come far in advance. With his way above average IQ, not only will he be able to provide himself with the latest high-tech comfort, getting rid of the Lemmings should be a piece of cake.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings prepare a dream afternoon snack with the last jar of chocolate spread in the cupboard. Tough luck, Grizzy is coming! Caught off guard, the Lemmings hide the jar in a teddy bear-pajama case to slip away without arousing suspicion. But Grizzy is captivated by the stuffed bear and makes it his security blanket.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself, but when the time comes to print his portrait, there's no more paper in the printer. The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a full crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate. Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Sourbette and Trasher, the new Kazoom Kid villains, join Kid Fury and the Villains in a new adventure.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Legion of Zoom wants to prove they’re better than the Batwheels at doing good for Gotham, so they form their own super-team!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Batman calls on his newest, amazingly flexible vehicle – the Tumbler – to help him navigate the Joker’s funhouse lair.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Bibi and Batgirl are surprised to run into Harley and Jestah at their favorite popstar’s concert, and now they’ve all got to team up to save the show!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Kitty splashes in Ultra Grow-Gas she grows enormous! Now the Batwheels must keep her, and Gotham, safe until she shrinks back down to normal.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a float to lead the Flower Parade, but Porky won’t settle for anything less than Porky Perfect.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired to build a rollercoaster for Looneyburg. Bugs and Daffy soon get caught up trying to prove their part of the coaster is the best.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Sam Sheepdog hires The Looney Builders to build him a salon. Sam offers his custom cut only to learn that different folks want different styles.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Pro snowboarder Pepper Polar Bear hires The Looney Builders to build a ski resort. Pepper soon learns that others have different skill levels.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean inadvertently causes an accident which prevents Irma taking the scout troop to Big Bear’s Scout Camp. With the scout master and mini bus out of action Mr Bean steps in to save the day. As temporary scoutmaster Mr Bean enjoys his new role but his obsessive badge collecting wins him no friends within the group.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park. There’s a case of mistaken identity and Mr Bean finds himself teaching a class of unruly school kids. Bean uses every trick in the book to win them over and ends up teaching the headmaster how to be a success in school.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod. Grizzy steals their stick and finds a Yummy deposit in the savanna. To take control over Grizzy’s discovery, the Lemmings set a trap to draw the bear far from the deposit and transform it into an industrial chocolate factory. Grizzy will want to recover his chocolate deposit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is jealous of the Lemmings’ new game: an interactive dance mat connected to the TV where the idea is to jump around and perform dance sequences. As they fight over the mat, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism in one of the Great Wall of China’s watchtowers. The mechanism activates a game on the wall’s paving stones that is similar to the interactive mat, only life size. On your marks, get ready, dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are hungry! While fighting over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the jar is destroyed. But Grizzy discovers an ingenious manner to recover the remains of another Yummy jar using instant Chinese noodles as inspiration. The result is delicious. Grizzy and the Lemmings will once again fight over this new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings, who are both starving, discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche. According to the book lying open inside the temple, to obtain a perfect brioche you must gather three gold ingredients and set them on the altar. When the panda idol who guards the temple receives the offering, the person will receive his favorite food in abundance. Grizzy and Lemmings set out to find the sacred ingredients but there is no question of working together. May the best critter win!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An integrated circuit containing an artificial intelligence accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life like a modern-day Pinocchio. Grizzy educates the chip until it decides to connect to the Lemmings’ robot to play with them. When the AI becomes a teenager, it is no longer interested in either Grizzy or the Lemmings and prefers using a smartphone to keep learning. Grizzy and the Lemmings join efforts to try and reset the chip’s memory and relive its childhood phase over and over.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a large silkworm that produces an extremely soft and resilient elastic thread ad infinitum. The Lemmings consider the worm the ideal game companion, but Grizzy needs the worm to make his knitwear. To become masters of the silkworm, the close enemies will go to harsh extremes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. Grizzy is not very enthusiastic about this new electric activity which keeps him from sleeping. While Grizzy thinks that he got rid of their lanterns, the Lemmings discover new high-tech lanterns capable of making even more of a ruckus.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console that lets you play life-sized games in the real world. The console emits magical streams of energy that randomly pick avatars to confront one another. Grizzy is chosen as the hero. He must leap onto platforms and confront both enemies and a fearsome leader: a panda equipped with bamboo sticks. The Lemmings are obviously in control of the joystick!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As the Lemmings rummage through an abandoned delivery tricycle filled with strange objects, they discover a delicious treasure: Yummy-filled Chinese brioches! Grizzy steals their tasty bounty and heads off to enjoy it alone in the cabin. The Lemmings find a mask in the tricycle that terrifies anyone who looks at it when it’s being worn by someone. The Lemmings intend to use their horrific new power to recover their stolen treats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of Yummy which is mysteriously sucked up into a strange gravestone locked with a puzzle. Grizzy smashes open the gravestone but it contains another box made of unbreakable wood protected with a codex system. Our characters crack the code and are sucked into the box in turn. They discover that to get out, they will have to resolve a series of new puzzles, each one more complex than the last.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant home cinema screen that transforms his favorite documentary film into an incredible light and sound experience. But his pleasure is ruined by the Lemmings’ fiesta. While he chases after his housemates to destroy their disco equipment, he discovers with astonishment that Asian clones of himself and the Lemmings are also engaged in a high-speed pursuit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs are so obsessed with catching Lamput that even in their dreams, the chase goes on. It’s really not a restful sleep, when you keep waking up sweating from horrid visions that, let’s face it, just remind you what a nightmare your day job is. The Docs make the brave decision to see a therapist about these terrible dreams. In the waiting room is the last orange blob they wanted to see; apparently a life of hot pursuit is taking its toll on Lamput, too. The shrink will have to resort to some very unconventional treatments.

programme.desc: Dotty, now stuck in the past and with nobody recognising her, goes to her uncle for help and they must work together to bring her back to present-day MoleTown without interfering with the past.

programme.desc: When a cell phone falls into Roley Poley park from the Great Above, the entire town is mesmerized by it and Moley must break the “spell” it has on them.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a super-fan takes an unwelcome swim at a celebrity's house; a man goes wild at the gym and on the streets of Miami - totally naked; and more!

programme.title: #Dead2Me
programme.desc: Bennylyn Burke moved to the UK from the Philippines, hoping for a better life. Tragically, she would be targeted by cruel killer Andrew Innes, who used computer software to target her on a dating site… then lure her to her death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter
programme.desc: Kenda thinks he's chasing a promising lead as he investigates a mysterious shooting, but it soon emerges that he's barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Booked: First Day In
programme.desc: In Florida, an elderly woman gets arrested for domestic battery after fighting with her sister. Meanwhile in Virginia Beach, a 19-year-old boy gets extradited from Miami, after missing his court date, to face an old marijuana charge.

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: Each episode tells the story of how an online connection led to murder. Whether it’s the excitement of online dating, the lure of money-making schemes, or the chance to cheat on your partner, every story is different, but everyone has a tragic end.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When the body of a woman turns up in a field in Huntington Beach, CA, in 1968, police simultaneously seek a killer and the identity of the victim herself. It takes 52 years for detectives to solve this dual mystery and expose a vicious predator.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In 1977 Florida Nurse Deborah Clark, 23, is found brutally slain in her home. Detectives unearth an affair, a jilted wife, and a web of money and power, but no true suspect. It will take 40 years and advanced DNA testing to expose Deb's killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 34-year-old Freddie Farah is gunned down in his Florida grocery store, police urgently seek his killer. Decades later, Farah's son will have a chance encounter with a cold case detective which brings the case back to life and exposes a killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Tara Sidarovich goes missing from her Punta Gorda home, Florida Police consider her a runaway. Then her body turns up in a swamp. Shocking prison recordings will send detectives on a nationwide hunt for her killer.

programme.title: Sunshine Slayings

programme.title: Slepkavība motelī
programme.desc: 2020. gada 6. septembra rītā policija saņem satraucošu zvanu uz 911 - 32 gadus vecais Braiens Džemals Redings raud un kliedz, ka atradis savu 16 gadus veco draudzeni Saipresu Nūnanu mirušu Forest Motel numuriņā Ridžlendā. Saipresa Nūnana neizdzīvoja pēc šāviena galvā. Viņas ķermenis tika atrasts uz gultas, kas liek domāt, ka viņa nebija baidījusies no uzbrucēja. Kad ierodas izmeklētāji, Braiena Redinga dīvainā uzvedība nozieguma vietā rada nopietnas aizdomas.

programme.title: Ņujorkas slepkavība
programme.desc: Linda Steina bija slavenību nekustamo īpašumu māklere, viņa pārdeva Ņujorkas luksusa dzīvokļus Stīvenam Spīlbergam, Brūsam Vilisam un Betei Midlerei. Kad Linda tiek atrasta mirusi savā dzīvoklī, slepkavība nekavējoties kļūst par avīžu pirmo lapu ziņu. Viņas personība bija sarežģīta, un Linda bija ieguvusi kā ienaidniekus, tā cienītājus. Ar ierobežotiem pierādījumiem no nozieguma vietas, tikai rūpīga meklēšana var identificēt viņas slepkavu.

programme.desc: Trīs bērnu māte Hollija Kantrela Oklahomas slimnīcas videokamerās redzama, izejot no ēkas, bet viņa nekad tā arī nenonāk mājās. Policija uzzina, ka Hollijai bija noslēpumi, un viņas mīļotie spriež, vai tam būtu bijusi saistība ar pazušanu.

programme.title: Sekss un slepkavības
programme.desc: Skaista divu bērnu māte Kristāla Makdauela pazuda viesuļvētras Hārvija laikā, kas plosās Hjūstonā. Novērošanas kameru video aizved izmeklētājus pie viņas slepkavas.

programme.title: Sentiksa
programme.desc: Atklājas informācija par to, kas notika naktī, kad Alisone pazuda, kamēr viņu ieinteresē gan Edvīns, gan Tailers. Emīlija izpēta Alisones pagātni. Ceļotāju ģimene piedzīvo šokējošu atklājumu ekskursijā ārpus kūrorta.

programme.title: Slepkavība motelī
programme.desc: 2020. gada 6. septembra rītā policija saņem satraucošu zvanu uz 911 - 32 gadus vecais Braiens Džemals Redings raud un kliedz, ka atradis savu 16 gadus veco draudzeni Saipresu Nūnanu mirušu Forest Motel numuriņā Ridžlendā. Saipresa Nūnana neizdzīvoja pēc šāviena galvā. Viņas ķermenis tika atrasts uz gultas, kas liek domāt, ka viņa nebija baidījusies no uzbrucēja. Kad ierodas izmeklētāji, Braiena Redinga dīvainā uzvedība nozieguma vietā rada nopietnas aizdomas.

programme.title: Ņujorkas slepkavība
programme.desc: Linda Steina bija slavenību nekustamo īpašumu māklere, viņa pārdeva Ņujorkas luksusa dzīvokļus Stīvenam Spīlbergam, Brūsam Vilisam un Betei Midlerei. Kad Linda tiek atrasta mirusi savā dzīvoklī, slepkavība nekavējoties kļūst par avīžu pirmo lapu ziņu. Viņas personība bija sarežģīta, un Linda bija ieguvusi kā ienaidniekus, tā cienītājus. Ar ierobežotiem pierādījumiem no nozieguma vietas, tikai rūpīga meklēšana var identificēt viņas slepkavu.
